values.note: 'Campsites can be reserved online at any time, by phone or at the campground office.' Two nights minimum on Friday+Saturday, one night allowed Sunday-Thursday; the booking site sold one-night weeknight stays (Oct 2026, Apr, May, Jun and Aug 2027) on both electric and non-electric sites and refused a one-night Friday.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/little-beaver-state-park/lodging/camping-at-little-beaver-state-park/ ('Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday, Saturday) or one night during the week (Sunday – Thursday)'; 'There is a maximum stay of 14 consecutive nights') + book.wvstateparks.com suppliers 11067593/7989180 (one night 2026-10-27, 2027-04-20, 2027-05-11, 2027-06-15, 2027-08-10 sold; one night Fri 2027-06-18 none; 2027-06-18/20 sold), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booking site, Oct 2026 to Aug 2027, weeknights and weekends alike: water-only sites $36.99 a night, electric/water sites $49.99. The primitive group camping area (up to 40) is rented separately.
